messages:
zara_finance: Noticing a vendor billing mismatch from AWS Marketplace for Aug. Channel invoice shows partner 'reseller-900' billed at list price; expected channel discount lines missing. Delta approx $6,480. Anyone seen missing discount rows in recent exports?

pete_revops: I saw a note about AWS changing discount attribution keys last week. Could be our discount join failed. @anya_billing can you pull the raw CSV key?

anya_billing: S3 key: s3://redwood-billing/aws/2026/08/31/part-07.csv
anya_billing: sample raw row:
```
invoice_id,partner_id,usage_amount,discount_key,channel_id
inv-20260831,partner-900,6480,dk-44,
```

aws-bot: AWS marketplace update: "discount_key" introduced 2026-08-29 for programmatic discount linking; reseller channel may show empty channel_id for consolidated exports. https://aws.example/marketplace/notes (automated)

sam_partner_ops: Partners will expect quick fix. If reingest can't finish before payout, propose issuing manual credit.

pete_revops: Approve manual credit for up to $7k for this partner to avoid payout disruption. Record approval in finance-approvals.

anya_billing: Created ticket BILL-7102 to add fallback join using discount_key+partner_id. Scheduled reingest 2026-09-02 04:00 UTC. Will post results here and void credit if reingest reconciles.

zara_finance: Thanks team. Please include partner contact in the ticket and draft the memo. If reingest shows systemic exposure, we'll escalate.
